STYLE: match the attached concept art — premium cinematic dark-fantasy digital painting like AAA fantasy RPG key art: rich painterly detail, believable materials, warm amber lantern and candle light against cool blue shadows, burnished gold accents, gentle atmospheric haze. Use the concepts for style only; never copy their interface panels, characters, labels or text. Absolutely no text, letters, numbers, runes that read as letters, logos, interface, borders or watermarks.

The attached image is the approved canonical reference. Draw full-body painted tabletop miniature of the same figure standing on a round dark stone base, three-quarter view from slightly above, isolated on a pure flat black background (#000000), no cast shadow beyond the base. Keep the same figure's face, build, clothing and colours exactly; change only what this variant requires.
FRAMING: square 1:1.

Then copy the generated PNG into the current working directory as reed-smuggler--figure.png and reply only with that file name.
